distribution.summary: 重庆；福建；甘肃；广东；广西；海南；西藏；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2024) adds Fujian and confirms Guangdong and Guangxi as new provincial evidence; prior regions remain. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides additional secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Lin et al. (2024) directly reports Mytilaria laosensis; Quercus sp. is retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the species as polyphagous, but the broad statement is retained at source level and does not add current host taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus mancus (Blandford, 1898).

taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 388.

taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 186.

taxonomic_history.name: Xylosandrus mancus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Xylosandrus mancus (Blandford, 1898), VSN_6532. 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Xyleborus mancus formosanus. Beaver & Liu (2010) notes that Taiwanese Xyleborus mancus formosanus lies within the variation of Xylosandrus mancus, supporting treatment under the current species identity.
